accessibility.scope: Static response HTML in isolated browser; page scripts removed; not an authenticated or interaction audit.

responsive.scope: Static response HTML/CSS only; JavaScript-driven layout and interactive navigation were not executed.

security.construction: Remote markup was parsed and reconstructed from an inert semantic allowlist; scripts, event handlers, SVG, embedded content and URL-bearing attributes were omitted. A per-scan CSP nonce permits only the local axe engine.

findings.title: Forms found; WebLab did not submit them.
findings.evidence: 2 form(s) inspected structurally; submission, validation and success/error flows were not exercised.
findings.fix: Use the dedicated form-flow check in a safe staging environment; never submit a production form as part of this scan.

findings.title: Link could not be checked.
findings.evidence: Page exceeds the safe scan-size limit.
findings.fix: Review the destination, update the link, or remove it if no longer relevant.

findings.title: Some stylesheet files were not included in the responsive check.
findings.evidence: Found 15 stylesheet links; WebLab checks up to 6 and does not follow CSS @import rules.
findings.fix: Treat responsive findings as a sampled check; inspect remaining and imported stylesheets for a complete result.

findings.title: Accessibility: aria-prohibited-attr.
findings.evidence: Ensure ARIA attributes are not prohibited for an element's role
findings.fix: Inspect the affected elements (section[data-product-carousel="form"] > .pc-stage > div[aria-label="1 of 5"][data-pc-label="Product artwork"][data-pc-kind="artwork"] > .pc-inspect[aria-label="View product artwork"][title="View full artwork"], section[data-product-carousel="luma"] > .pc-stage > div[aria-label="1 of 5"][data-pc-label="Product artwork"][data-pc-kind="artwork"] > .pc-inspect[aria-label="View product artwork"][title="View full artwork"], section[data-product-carousel="stemdeck"] > .pc-stage > div[aria-label="1 of 5"][data-pc-label="Product artwork"][data-pc-kind="artwork"] > .pc-inspect[aria-label="View product artwork"][title="View full artwork"], section[data-product-carousel="scenepilot"] > .pc-stage > div[aria-label="1 of 5"][data-pc-label="Product artwork"][data-pc-kind="artwork"] > .pc-inspect[aria-label="View product artwork"][title="View full artwork"]) and make the smallest WCAG-aligned correction.
